title: Write about 80 new held-out rows from real kb-user questions, committed before any eval run of them
goal: Add about 80 rows to kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv, 95 to 105 in all with unique HO- ids and the file's columns, at least 50 expecting good with the article that answers them, at least 10 partial (weak, or good with allow_weak yes) and at least 10 absent (none, no paths), each a question a kb user would ask, worded as a session asks it; the rows stay as first committed, with no edit after their first eval run; no row rewords a tuned row or a doc2query expansion, and the eval refuses none

run: import csv,sys;r=list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv',encoding='utf-8')));g=sum(x['expect_verdict']=='good' and not x['allow_weak'] for x in r);p=sum(x['expect_verdict']=='weak' or (x['expect_verdict']=='good' and x['allow_weak']=='yes') for x in r);n=sum(x['expect_verdict']=='none' for x in r);ids=[x['id'] for x in r];print(len(r),g,p,n);sys.exit(0 if 95<=len(r)<=105 and g>=50 and p>=10 and n>=10 and len(set(ids))==len(ids) and all(i.startswith('HO-') for i in ids) else 1)

import subprocess,sys,csv,io;f='kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv';log=subprocess.run(['git','log','--reverse','--format=%H','ae319c43c5..HEAD','--',f],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split();rows=lambda r:subprocess.run(['git','show',r+':'+f],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;first=next((c for c in log if len(list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(rows(c)))))>=95),None);print('first grown commit:',first);sys.exit(0 if first and rows(first)==open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() else 1)

clauses.clause: Add about 80 rows to kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv, 95 to 105 in all with unique HO- ids and the file's columns, at least 50 expecting good with the article that answers them, at least 10 partial (weak, or good with allow_weak yes) and at least 10 absent (none, no paths), each a question a kb user would ask, worded as a session asks it
the rows stay as first committed, with no edit after their first eval run
no row rewords a tuned row or a doc2query expansion

notes: Process rules (planning 2026-10-14, the operator's held-out conditions): questions come from the query log store's lookup records where one fits (placeholders for private names, never a backlog item's text), else are written as a kb user would ask; expected paths and verdicts come from reading the articles (rag.py show, rag.py facts, git grep), never from rag.py pack or eval output on the new questions; before the commit, test only for rewordings with python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import rag;print(rag.heldout_rewordings('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv','public'))" (no pack runs) and replace any question it names; commit the rows, then run the eval: that first run is the one measurement, and no row changes after it (the frozen-rows check reads git history from ae319c43c5). The eval check passes on today's 20 rows by design (it guards REWORD and OFFKB refusals); the frozen-rows check fails until the grown rows are committed.
